```{r}
#| include: false
Vs30.target <- 760
SiteID.caption <- .requireOneTarget(
  .currentTarget("siteID.target"), "siteID.target", "MCE spectrum caption"
)
if (!exists("Sa.log", inherits = FALSE)) Sa.log <- TRUE
if (identical(ID.target, "MCE")) {
  Scn <- NULL
  CAP <- CAP |>
    sprintf(paste(p.target, collapse = ", "), Vs30.target, SiteID.caption)
} else {
  Scn <- ScenarioTable[ID %in% ID.target]
  if ("siteID" %in% names(Scn) && exists("siteID.target", inherits = FALSE)) {
    Scn <- Scn[siteID %in% siteID.target]
  }
  CAP <- CAP |>
    sprintf(
      ID.target,
      TRT.text[[Scn$TRT]],
      Scn$Mw,
      round(Scn$Repi),
      paste(p.target, collapse = ", "),
      Vs30.target,
      SiteID.caption
    )
}
```
